description: Labeled longitudinal-retrieval benchmark. 'history' is one patient's PatientStatus rows over ~6 months (plus rows for a second patient that must never be returned). Each row belongs to a symptom 'family': every row of a family is relevant to a query about that family, and the family's most recent row (by clinical time) is its current status. Queries are given the way the workflow builds them (symptom label, keywords, aligned watch-for, and context), so this isolates retrieval from symptom extraction.
